nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum

segments.oily: One combination/acne-prone reviewer reports the serum helps balance oil production while hydrating.
segments.dry: Multiple reviewers with dry skin, including one describing skin as "normally dry," report strong hydration, relief of dry patches, and a smoother, plumper feel, though one dry-skin reviewer reports the serum also caused breakouts and increased dryness for her.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report the serum helps with dry patches and is hydrating without greasiness, and one combination/acne-prone reviewer calls it her best serum.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most often report calming of redness and irritation with no burning or breakouts, though one reviewer who self-describes as "extra sensitive" reports breakouts and dryness after use, and one review reports the product caused burning, redness, and barrier damage.
segments.mature: One mature-skin reviewer reports good hydration without greasiness, and another reviewer mentions the line generally addressing fine lines and wrinkles.
segments.normal: Reviewers who don't specify a skin issue generally report a lightweight, fast-absorbing feel and visible hydration.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports the serum plumps fine lines and wrinkles as part of overall hydration; no other aging-specific outcomes are detailed.
concerns.dehydration: The great majority of reviewers report visible, lasting hydration, plumping, and a smoother, softer feel, including in dry winter conditions; one reviewer reports no noticeable difference in hydration and felt it was "like water."
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including one with breakout- and redness-prone skin and one describing herself as sensitive, report reduced redness and calming; one reviewer reports the opposite, developing new redness and a burning sensation.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the serum helped strengthen and repair her skin barrier and improved comfort during a stressed/dry period, while another reports the product actively damaged her skin barrier, causing burning and redness that required switching serums.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the serum helped with enlarged, congested pores as her main problem area; no other spot-specific comments appear.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne- or breakout-prone skin mostly report no new breakouts and faster post-acne recovery/skin tone improvement, but one reviewer reports new breakouts on the cheek and chin days after starting use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the serum helps balance oil production; a different reviewer reports the serum leaves the face "too dewy"/overly shiny for her taste.

extraits.texte: I packed this product as part of a trip to Europe over the holidays because I knew my skin would need more moisture. It did not go well. My face would start to burn a little after application and I actually developed redness from using it. I ended up purchasing different serums on my trip in order to save my skin barrier.

extraits.titre: Decent serum but not for me
extraits.texte: I like the feel of it and the smell but I will say I had some break outs with it. I applied it after cleansing and toning, but before my moisturizer. It didn't burn or sting, but a few days after using, I had some breakouts on my cheek and chin. My skin also felt a bit more dry even with my tried and true moisturizer. I'm not sure this is the serum for me. It isn't overpowering for smell and a little goes a long way. It may work for other people but my skin can be extra sensitive. The gel consistency also makes it easier to put on.

I have skin that is prone to breakouts and redness. So I'm usually pretty cautious about which products I use on my skin. And I am so happy that I found this product! It adds a lot of hydration and helps calm down any redness. I also have noticed that my breakouts go away faster. The texture is perfect because it absorbs into the skin quick and doesnt leave a sticky residue. Highly recommend this product!

This is a very hydrating and non sticky hyaluronic acid serum, with the added benefits of cica. This in conjunction with the luxurious matching cream is a great daytime or barrier repair routine for those with dry and sensitive skin like me.
Grest for my combindation skin type and acne prone skin. Best serum I have tried!
I love this line! Great for my mature skin and leaves me so hydrated, but not greasy. I will continue these products for life!

extraits.titre: No more red blotches & healthy glow!
extraits.texte: I'm 59 and have been using this for many months now. I have noticed a huge difference in the clarity of my skin & redness. I put it on my face right after shower, give it a few minutes then moisturize. My friends even noticed how good my skin looks!
